pages.text: $(l)Purpose$()$pTall generator with burst-based lightning output and linked Weather Stations/Transmitters.$p$(l)Set up and operate$()$p1. Leave the reserved vertical height clear.$p2. Place stations at the same height within their configured range.$p3. Provide buffer space and a permitted output route.$p$(l)When it does not run$()$pOutput is burst-based. A full buffer or slow connection can make the mast appear idle between strikes.$pRead the active server settings below before copying default costs from another installation. For special slot roles, use the machine screen labels. Settings reporting does not inspect or mutate a placed machine.$pActual server settings: live server values are available in the native or master Foundations reader.$pProcessing / value recipes: live recipe details are available in the native or master Foundations reader.$pCrafting / obtaining this machine: live recipe details are available in the native or master Foundations reader.$p$(l:foundations_calculator:multiblocks/mast)Mast and station placement$()
